title: canirun model catalog entry
description: One file per model in models/<id>.yaml. Flat key: value only (no nesting). Numbers come from the model's config.json on Hugging Face. Check with: canirun validate models/<id>.yaml

id.description: Unique id, also the file name (models/<id>.yaml)

aliases.description: Names people type, e.g. Ollama tags like llama3.1:8b. Must be unique across the catalog.

params_b.description: Total parameters in billions (HF safetensors total)

active_params_b.description: Mixture-of-experts only: parameters read per token, in billions
